rachel_customer: Hi team — customer Acme running rerank v1.2.3 intermittently gets 500s and some bizarre scores (negative or ~0). Happened after they upgraded an internal library. I have a sample payload and truncated server error.

alex_support: thanks — can you paste the minimal repro payload + request_id?

rachel_customer: payload below (they say they didn't sanitize user search inputs). note the embedded null and emoji in the query and one candidate.

```json
{"query":"best sushi 🍣\u0000 in nyc","candidates":["Sushi places 🍣","Sushi — Tokyo","Sushi\u0000corrupt"],"top_k":3}
```

request_id: req_01H7Q3XJ9Y0

server error (truncated):
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/runtime/rerank/handler.py", line 214, in handle_request
    scores = reranker.score(query, candidates)
  File "/srv/runtime/rerank/reranker.py", line 87, in score
    tokens = tokenizer.encode(text)
ValueError: embedded null byte
```

alex_support: ok that ValueError is helpful. @maria_engineering can you confirm if tokenizer/utf8 path currently blows up on embedded NULs or if this is from downstream C extensions?

maria_engineering: looking. quick note: our tokenizer wrapper historically assumes utf-8 validated strings. C tokenizer may raise on \x00 depending on binding. I want a small repro. @rachel_customer can you run this locally and paste stdout?

rachel_customer: ran quick python repro and got same ValueError. snippet I used:

```python
import requests
p = {"query":"hi \u0000 there","candidates":["a","b"]}
r = requests.post("https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank", json=p, headers={"Authorization":"Bearer X"})
print(r.status_code)
print(r.text)
```

josh_sre: any recent deploys? runtimes_bot, show last deploy for rerank service.

runtimes_bot: last successful deploy: rerank-service@2026-03-01T18:12:07Z by deploy-bot. No hotfix deploys since.

maria_engineering: hypothesis: embedded NULs are slipping through from client libs that don't sanitize; our C tokenizer layer chokes and raises ValueError which bubbles and becomes 500. Also saw earlier threads where surrogate pairs + nulls caused inconsistent score scaling. We should at minimum validate/normalize input at the HTTP boundary.

alex_support: customer is asking for a hotfix or workaround. suggested immediate mitigation: sanitize inputs before send or use header to enable server-side sanitization? customer cannot change all clients quickly.

maria_engineering: short-term: patch at router to reject or strip NULs and return 400 with a helpful message. medium-term: make tokenizer resilient by treating \x00 as NOP or removing before tokenization. I'll open a bug and PR.

alex_support: suggested customer workaround (works for them): sanitize in their client -> replace('\x00','') and unicode normalize. snippet we gave them: 

```python
import unicodedata
def clean(s):
    s = s.replace('\x00','')
    s = unicodedata.normalize('NFKC', s)
    # remove lone surrogates
    return ''.join(ch for ch in s if not (0xD800 <= ord(ch) <= 0xDFFF))
```

rachel_customer: applied that to their pipeline and immediate failures stopped, scores look reasonable now. They still want a permanent server fix and regression test.

maria_engineering: assigning bug INF-3221: "rerank: handle embedded NUL and invalid UTF-8 gracefully". Will add unit tests with combos: emoji + \u0000, surrogate pairs, percent-encoded null bytes. Also add a prometheus metric for input_sanitization_rejects.

josh_sre: create a support ticket and notify enterprise success — track SLA impact. alex, can you file PSR and paste ticket id here?

alex_support: filed case CS-67890 and linked INF-3221. Notifying Acme about workaround and ETA for patch (ETA EOW). :thumbsup:

rachel_customer: thanks, passing to customer. they asked whether encoding could corrupt scores (they saw one candidate score go from 0.82 to 0.003 when NUL was present).

maria_engineering: yes, weird tokenization leads to different token sequences and thus very different logits — explains score cliff. we'll add regression to pin model outputs for sanitized vs unsanitized inputs.

alex_support: closing loop: customer happy with workaround, patch in progress, ticket CS-67890, bug INF-3221. Will update when PR lands. :white_check_mark:

rachel_customer: appreciated. Reacts: :heart:
